title: Weak-* convergence of derivatives of uniformly Lipschitz, uniformly convergent functions against L¹ vector fields
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ and K ≥ 0. Let u_k : ℝ^d → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) be K-Lipschitz functions converging uniformly on ℝ^d to u : ℝ^d → ℝ, and let Φ : ℝ^d → ℝ^d be Lebesgue integrable. With Dv(y) the Fréchet derivative (fderiv; 0 where v is not differentiable) and Bochner integrals for Lebesgue measure, ∫ Du_k(y)[Φ(y)] dy → ∫ Du(y)[Φ(y)] dy as k → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (K : NNReal) (us : ℕ → Euclid d → ℝ) (u : Euclid d → ℝ) (Φ : Euclid d → Euclid d), (∀ k, LipschitzWith K (us k)) → TendstoUniformly us u atTop → Integrable Φ → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y, fderiv ℝ (us k) y (Φ y)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y, fderiv ℝ u y (Φ y)))
